Here is the audit report.

---

**Priority 1 -- `console.log` in catch blocks (should be `console.error`)**

`analytics.svelte.ts` has three catch blocks using `console.log` instead of `console.error` (one catch at line 68 already uses `console.error`, proving the intent):

- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\analytics.svelte.ts:35`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\analytics.svelte.ts:50`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\services\analytics.svelte.ts:82`

Two more error-path `console.log` calls:

- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\utils\supabase-client.ts:200`
- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\supabaseProfile.svelte.ts:41`

**Priority 2 -- `: any` / `as any` types (28 occurrences)**

High-value fixes (types are knowable):

| File:Line | Suggested Type |
|---|---|
| `analytics.svelte.ts:34,49,67,81` | `error: any` -- use `unknown` with `instanceof Error` guard |
| `analytics.svelte.ts:78` | `session: any` -- use the auth session type from `@auth/sveltekit` |
| `hooks.server.ts:14` | `profile: any` -- use `GithubProfile` from `@auth/core/providers/github` |
| `hooks.client.ts:5` | `globalThis as any` -- declare a global interface augmentation |
| `types.ts:57,59` (themes) | `currentTheme`/`lightMode` -- type from Skeleton UI theme API |
| `types.ts:54` (connect) | `intervalId: any` -- use `ReturnType<typeof setInterval>` |
| `TalkMozilla.svelte:22,24,29` | canvas/pdfDoc/pages -- use `HTMLCanvasElement`, pdfjs types |
| `TalkAdobe.svelte:33` | `adobeDCView: any` -- declare an interface for Adobe DC SDK |
| `LoContextTree.svelte:12,14,25` / `LoContext.svelte:20` | use the `Lo` model type instead of `any` |

**Priority 3 -- Hardcoded URLs (6 occurrences)**

- `ConnectedProfile.svelte:51` -- `https://time.tutors.dev/`
- `TutorsTimeIndicator.svelte:8` -- `https://time.tutors.dev/`
- `presence.svelte.ts:101,123` -- `https://tutors.dev`
- `search/+page.svelte:52` -- `https://tutors.dev/`
- `TutorsVersion.svelte:5` -- `https://tutors.dev`

These should reference a `PUBLIC_TUTORS_BASE_URL` / `PUBLIC_TIME_BASE_URL` env var.

**Priority 4 -- Last Svelte 4 `on:` directive**

- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\navigators\buttons\SearchButton.svelte:48` -- `on:click={toggleSearch}` should migrate to `onclick={toggleSearch}`.

**Priority 5 -- ESLint suppressions worth revisiting**

- `lo-tree.ts:91-102` -- Six `no-unsafe-optional-chaining` suppressions. The optional-chained spreads (`...compositeLo?.panels?.panelVideos`) would produce `undefined` spread if the chain fails. Adding null guards would let these suppressions be removed.
- `festive.svelte.ts:1,16,19` -- blanket `ban-ts-comment` + `no-undef` suppression for the festive animation; worth typing properly.

**Priority 6 -- Dead commented-out code**

- `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\utils\supabase-client.ts:323-327` -- four commented-out function calls.
- `D:\code\tutors\src\hooks.server.ts:41` -- commented-out alternative `maxAge` line.

**Priority 7 -- Debug `console.log` statements (not in catch blocks)**

- `NotFound.svelte:10` -- `console.log(params)`
- `themes.svelte.ts:162` -- `console.log("No type found for icon", type)`
- `catalogue.ts:53,66,67,82` -- catalogue debug logging
- `TalkAdobe.svelte:67` -- `console.log(page.data?.lo?.pdf)`

These should be removed or converted to a debug-level logger.
